full_name: Amanda Wensley Peet | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Amanda Wensley Peet, an assistant professor of physics and mathematics at the University of Toronto, studies the field of string theory, which aims to explain the fundamental structure of matter and interactions from the subatomic to the cosmological realm.
